claude.reason: The clause names the 5th-percentile terminal multiple, which the scales block identifies as primary_metric_best (tm_q05), a multiple of contributed capital breaking even at 1.0. It closes the family only if NO cell reaches above 1.0. Four symbols report cells above that threshold: ETHUSDT 3.6056, BTCUSDT 2.0510, SOLUSDT 1.6619 and BNBUSDT 1.1261. These are the tm_q05 values at cells that were selected by ranking on mwrr_q05, so they are a lower bound on each symbol's best tm_q05 -- the true maximum can only be higher, and the clause is already unmet on the reported values alone. I did not use the mwrr_q05 ranking values (e.g. ETHUSDT 0.6789, BTCUSDT 0.3616), which are annualised returns breaking even at 0.0 and are not the scale the clause names. The clause as written is not met, so the verdict is CONTINUE. That is a verdict about the sentence, not an endorsement of the evidence: the shape diagnostic reads SPIKE on all four symbols above 1.0 (plateau ratios -1.0119, -1.9526, -2.0692, -5.4885), the search test returns INDISTINGUISHABLE_FROM_SEARCH for both symbols where it ran (ETHUSDT p=0.725, SOLUSDT p=0.79), PBO is uncomputable on all three attempted symbols, and independent_paths_best is between 1.02 and 1.40 -- roughly one experiment per symbol. None of that is in the pre-registered kill condition, so none of it can close the family here.

claude.reason: Clause 3 names the recorded shape of each symbol's best cell, and the surface records it explicitly: 'shape': 'SPIKE' on ADAUSDT, AVAXUSDT, BNBUSDT, BTCUSDT, DOGEUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT — 7 of the 9 symbols, against a threshold of 5 or more. ETHUSDT and LTCUSDT are the only two that do not read SPIKE, and only because their peaks are negative (-0.03335 and -0.34115), so the ratio is 'unmeasurable' — those two cannot rescue the clause. Unlike H0006, the five ordinal levels of timeframe_hours gave the diagnostic something to compute and it computed SPIKE, with plateau_ratio as low as 0.04365 on XRPUSDT and 0.09563 on SOLUSDT and outright negative (-0.1598) on ADAUSDT: the neighbouring timeframes do not carry the peak. Clause 3 is met, so the family closes. For the record, the clauses that did not close it: clause 1 was survived — cci_breakout at t=2 records calmar > 0 on 6 of 9 symbols (AVAX 0.64370, BNB 0.10188, BTC 0.13645, DOGE 3.00629, SOL 0.33647, XRP 0.21802) with n_liquidations_best = 0 on all nine reported best cells; and clause 2 was survived decisively — cci_reversion reaches calmar > 0 on 0 of 9 symbols at every timeframe, so the opposite rule never also gets paid, which is precisely the duel resolving rather than the indicator reading dispersion. Clauses 4 and 5 could not be checked at all because the payload carries neither cost-stressed values nor gross_collected, and an unrun check is not a check that passed.
